announcements.headline: EQS-News: Symrise delivered strong volume-driven organic sales growth in Q3 2026 and reaffirms full-year outlook
announcements.insight: Symrise reaffirms its full-year outlook following strong Q3 volume-driven organic sales growth. This builds on the solid H1 performance reported in July.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Symrise expands global production platform for sustainable musk fragrance ingredient
announcements.insight: Symrise expands its global production platform for sustainable musk fragrance ingredients. This follows its solid H1 2026 performance and acquisition of Floral Concept.

announcements.headline: EQS-CMS: Symrise AG: Release of a capital market information
EQS-News: Symrise reports solid H1 2026 performance with accelerating growth momentum in Q2
announcements.insight: Symrise reports solid H1 2026 performance with accelerating growth momentum in Q2. This follows the July acquisition of Floral Concept via a put option agreement.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Symrise signs a put option agreement to acquire Floral Concept
announcements.insight: Symrise AG has signed a put option agreement to acquire Floral Concept. This marks its first recorded acquisition activity.
